newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves to system via 9-day fixed RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves to system via 9-day fixed RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added reserves to the banking system via a round of nine-day fixed-system repurchase agreements (RPs) on Tuesday, the Federal Reserve Bank of New York confirmed.
The operation was not unexpected, as economists had been divided whether the Fed would add reserves or remain out of the banking system on Tuesday.
Federal funds were trading at 5.44 percent, slightly below the Fed's current official target level of 5-1/2 percent.
